messages:
Alex K: noticed a small spike in invoice-preview diffs for a handful of tenants — looks like +prefilled credits showing up twice in some previews. 1795558800->1795558850 window. anyone else seeing this?
Maria L: saw that too, triggered after yesterday's routing debounce tweak. not sure if it's forward-dup or counting at the tally step.
Jamal P: can you paste an example tenant id / event id? might be fingerprinting collision from the proxy.
Alex K: pasted one in logs: tenant t-4829, preview run id pr-2026-03-21-09, event ids look like colliding route_fingerprint sometimes.
Ciara H: quick thought — if edge proxy retries with new route_hint header we might be reattaching a different route_origin causing two distinct ledger keys. that would show up as two separate tokens in preview but only one real ingestion later.
Maria L: hm that matches my quick diffs. preview aggregates by (tenant, route_id) at the edge but final invoice uses (tenant, route_resolution_id). the recent debounce changed when route_resolution_id gets stamped. race possible.
Jamal P: proposal A: move debounce->dedupe earlier in the ingest service so we canonicalize route_resolution_id before emitting preview events. proposal B: keep at edge but emit a stable fingerprint header for the life of the request.
Alex K: Jamal, which is lower-risk?
Jamal P: B is lower-risk deploy-wise but it increases header propagation requirements for some proxies. A centralizes correctness but needs a small migration for preview pipeline to read post-canonicalization id.
Ciara H: telemetry cost concern: if we add a new stable fingerprint header and start emitting it everywhere, that'll add cardinality to traces and metrics. we should namespace it (route_fingerprint_v2) and only turn on for canary tenants.
Maria L: agree with canary. Also console UX: invoice-preview card currently shows two line items with slightly different labels — that confuses CS. we should update the card to surface "likely duplicate (debounce window)" when duplication confidence > 0.8.
Alex K: ok actionable list?
Jamal P: I'll prototype B (stable header) and a short middleware in the edge that sets route_fingerprint_v2 with the canonicalized fingerprint we already compute for fallback. will push a canary flag. ETA 2 days.
Maria L: I'll file a quick console patch to annotate the preview card and add a link to a troubleshooting doc. assigning to me, ETA 1 day.
Ciara H: I'll add a telemetry gating change: metric label only emitted when tenant in canary set (env var). also add an alert if duplicate-previews exceed threshold for >5 tenants in 30m.
Alex K: ingest-bot: ran a synthetic canary now covering the t-4829 case.
ingest-bot: synthetic run 1795559000 completed — forwarded 3 events, 2 deduped, 0 final-invoice-duplicates. details: https://internal/ci/1795559000
Maria L: thanks. if Jamal's header approach works we can avoid touching the tally service today.
Jamal P: quick snippet of middleware I'll try (will paste to PR):
```
# in edge middleware
def ensure_stable_fp(req):
  canonical = compute_canonical_fp(req.headers.get('route_hint'), req.path)
  req.headers['route_fingerprint_v2'] = canonical
  return req
```

Maria L: looks fine. please ensure the header is idempotent across retries.
Jamal P: will do, adding idempotency test.
Alex K: if we still see mismatches after canary we move to centralizing dedupe in ingest (proposal A). hopefully not needed.
Ciara H: noted. I'll update the runbook and telemetry PR once Jamal opens his.
Alex K: thanks all — logging this as follow-up in #eng-platform-action-items. :thumbsup:
